descriptionByLocale.it:
Eraneos è un gruppo internazionale di strategia, trasformazione e consulenza tecnologica, dedicato a potenziare le organizzazioni a prosperare in un'era digitale in continua evoluzione. Riunendo esperti di alto livello di business e tecnologia, aiutiamo i clienti a sollevare continuamente la barra in trasformazioni di successo, dalla strategia all'esecuzione. Che stiamo progettando organizzazioni future-ready, sbloccando il potenziale di dati e AI, o assicurando le aziende con una sicurezza informatica all'avanguardia, forniamo risultati pragmaticamente. Il nostro team di circa 1.200 professionisti dedicati ha sede in uffici in Svizzera, Germania, Paesi Bassi, Spagna, Danimarca, Svezia, Austria, Regno Unito, Singapore e Stati Uniti, e fonde perfettamente prospettive globali con forti radici locali. Circa 450 dipendenti lavorano nelle nostre sedi svizzere a Zurigo, Berna e Losanna. Questo è il lavoro – I vostri compiti principali:
• Consultare le principali aziende di scienze della vita su questioni strategiche relative ai dati, all'intelligenza artificiale e alla trasformazione.
• Sviluppare strategie di dati e AI, visioni di destinazione e roadmap con una chiara attenzione al valore aziendale e alla scalabilità.
• Structuring complesse sfide lungo la catena del valore, dalla ricerca e sviluppo a medico, regolamentare e commerciale.
• Programmi leader, workstream e team clienti con un focus su impatto, qualità e fattibilità.
• Tradurre le possibilità tecnologiche in decisioni di gestione robuste e corsi di azione prioritari.
• Costruire relazioni basate sulla fiducia con gli stakeholder senior e contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo della proposta e alla presenza del mercato.
• Sviluppare ulteriormente la pratica delle scienze della vita attraverso la leadership del pensiero, lo sviluppo degli affari e l'espansione delle relazioni strategiche dei clienti. Questo lavoro è per voi, se avete:
• Diversi anni di esperienza negli ambienti di consulenza, industria o trasformazione tecnologica, con particolare attenzione ai dati, all'intelligenza artificiale o all'analisi.
• Una solida comprensione dell'industria delle scienze della vita, idealmente in Ricerca, Sviluppo Clinico, Affari medici, Regolazione o Supply Chain.
• La capacità di strutturare rapidamente problemi complessi, li priorità pragmaticamente e guidarli verso un risultato chiaro utilizzando un approccio basato su ipotesi.
• Una prospettiva sui dati e l'intelligenza artificiale non solo come tecnologie, ma come leve per la creazione di valore, migliore processo decisionale e nuovi modelli di business.
• La fiducia nel lavorare con gli stakeholder senior e la capacità di distillare contenuti per il pubblico di livello gestionale in modo mirato e conciso.
• Una forte motivazione ad assumersi la responsabilità di programmi, relazioni con i clienti e lo sviluppo di un'offerta di consulenza.
• Molto buone competenze in lingua tedesca e inglese. Come la ciliegina sulla torta, si porta avanti
• Esperienza con GenAI, piattaforme di dati, governance AI o requisiti normativi in un contesto di scienze della vita.
• Risultato successo nello sviluppo aziendale, nella creazione di proposte o nella leadership di pensiero.
• Esperienza leader team interdisciplinari all'intersezione di business, tecnologia e trasformazione. Il prossimo passo verso un'applicazione di successo
• Jeffrey come persona di contatto non vede l'ora della vostra applicazione diretta tramite il nostro sito web (CV, diplomi e riferimenti in PDF). La diversità è molto apprezzata nella nostra azienda – mostraci cosa ti rende speciale e inviaci la tua applicazione oggi! *Le richieste via e-mail o da agenzie di reclutamento non saranno considerate e verranno eliminate.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Eraneos is an international strategy, transformation and technology consulting group, dedicated to empowering organizations to thrive in an ever-changing digital age. By bringing together top-tier experts from business and tech, we help clients to continuously raise the bar in successful transformations, from strategy to execution. Whether we’re designing future-ready organizations, unlocking the potential of data and AI, or securing businesses with cutting-edge cybersecurity, we deliver results pragmatically. Our team of around 1,200 dedicated professionals is based in offices across Switzerland, Germany, the Netherlands, Spain, Denmark, Sweden, Austria, the UK, Singapore, and the USA, and seamlessly blends global perspectives with strong local roots. Around 450 employees work at our Swiss locations in Zurich, Bern and Lausanne.

That’s the job – Your main tasks:

• Advising leading life sciences companies on strategic questions related to data, AI and transformation.

• Developing data & AI strategies, target visions and roadmaps with a clear focus on business value and scalability.

• Structuring complex challenges along the value chain, from Research & Development to Medical, Regulatory and Commercial.

• Leading programs, workstreams and client teams with a focus on impact, quality and feasibility.

• Translating technological possibilities into robust management decisions and prioritized courses of action.

• Building trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders and actively contributing to proposal development and market presence.

• Further developing the life sciences practice through thought leadership, business development and the expansion of strategic client relationships.

This job is for you, if you have:

• Several years of experience in consulting, industry or technology‑driven transformation environments with a focus on data, AI or analytics.

• A solid understanding of the life sciences industry, ideally in Research, Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Regulatory or Supply Chain.

• The ability to quickly structure complex issues, pragmatically prioritize them and steer them towards a clear outcome using a hypothesis‑driven approach.

• A perspective on data and AI not just as technologies, but as levers for value creation, better decision‑making and new business models.

• Confidence in working with senior stakeholders and the ability to distill content for management‑level audiences in a targeted and concise way.

• A strong motivation to take responsibility for programs, client relationships and the development of a consulting offering.

• Very good German and English language skills.

As the icing on the cake, you bring along

• Experience with GenAI, data platforms, AI governance or regulatory requirements in a life sciences context.

• Proven success in business development, proposal creation or thought leadership.

• Experience leading interdisciplinary teams at the intersection of business, technology and transformation.

Your next step towards a successful application

• Jeffrey as your contact person is looking forward to your direct application via our website (CV, diplomas and references in PDF).

Diversity is highly valued at our company – show us what makes you special and send us your application today!

*Applications by email or from recruitment agencies will not be considered and will be deleted.

Eraneos is an international management and technology consulting group that helps organisations thrive in an increasingly dynamic digital world. With first-class experts from business and technology, we empower our clients to set new standards for sustainable transformation – from strategy to execution. Whether shaping future-ready organisations, unlocking new potential through data and AI, or strengthening businesses through holistic cybersecurity, we deliver results in a pragmatic and targeted way.
Our team of around 1,200 dedicated professionals is based in offices across Switzerland, Germany, the Netherlands, Spain, Denmark, Sweden, Austria, the United Kingdom, Singapore and the USA, combining global perspectives with strong local roots. Around 460 employees work across our Swiss offices in Zurich, Bern and Lausanne.
In the Romandie market, this role sits at the intersection of client impact, market development and leadership. The focus is on building senior-level relationships, shaping transformative AI and Data agendas and turning strategic opportunities into meaningful consulting mandates with lasting business value.

That’s the job – your main tasks

• Driving business development and sales activities for AI and Data consulting engagements across the Romandie market, with a clear focus on growth, relevance and client impact

• Building trusted advisor relationships with C-level stakeholders and positioning AI as a strategic lever for business transformation, operating model evolution and competitive advantage

• Identifying, shaping and winning complex AI and Data opportunities, from early client dialogue through proposal development to mandate launch

• Leading high-impact consulting engagements from strategy through implementation oversight, while connecting AI initiatives with broader business and organisational transformation programmes

• Contributing to the growth of the local Data & AI practice through mentoring, team development, market visibility and close collaboration with Eraneos experts across Switzerland and Europe

This job is for you, if …

• extensive experience in consulting, business transformation and AI/Data advisory is combined with the seniority required to operate credibly at executive level

• a strong track record in selling, developing and leading consulting engagements related to AI, GenAI, Data or digital transformation can be demonstrated

• senior stakeholders can be engaged with confidence and AI can be positioned not as a trend topic, but as a concrete business and transformation agenda

• large-scale transformation initiatives have been shaped or led in complex environments, ideally with clear ownership for outcomes, stakeholder alignment and delivery quality

• strong expertise across current AI trends, LLM ecosystems, GenAI use cases and enterprise adoption challenges is complemented by fluent French at a minimum C1 level and professional English proficiency

As the icing on the cake, you bring along …

• experience in Public Sector, Utilities, Transport or other regulated industries

• an existing network in the Swiss Romandie market

• experience working in Swiss consulting environments

• a visible entrepreneurial mindset paired with strong ownership and market-building ambition

• the credibility and drive to help expand a high-performing AI & Data presence in Romandie

Even if not every requirement is fully met, we would still be very glad to receive your application.
